/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 9-hour shared-van shore excursion from Incheon Cruise Terminal to Seoul: ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G0⟧, ⟦G2⟧, ⟦G3⟧. EN guide.

/hero/meta/duration.source_en: ≈ 9 hours, calibrated to your cruise's port-call window

/hero/tagline.source_en: Four central-Seoul stops coordinated with your ship's schedule

/catalog_card/title.source_en: Incheon to Seoul: Cruise Day Tour

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: Seoul's central heritage, hanok, market, and crafts circuit from your Incheon cruise terminal.

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: Shared-van day tour from Incheon Cruise Terminal hitting Seoul's headline central-city stops in a single 9-hour window: ⟦G1⟧ (or Changdeokgung on Tuesdays), ⟦G0⟧, lunch at ⟦G2⟧ (the city's most-photographed streetfood alley), and ⟦G3⟧ cultural street. Pickup calibrated to your specific ship's disembarkation; certified English/Chinese-speaking guide; ≈75 min return drive built in.

/pickup_dropoff/notes/0.source_en: Provide ship name, port-call date, expected disembarkation time, and all-aboard time at booking. Pickup is at the Incheon Cruise Terminal in Songdo (the dedicated ocean-cruise terminal; do NOT confuse with the Incheon International Ferry Terminal or with Incheon Airport on Yeongjong Island). Shared van with other cruise passengers from various ships; if multiple ships sail at different times, earliest-sailing passengers are dropped first. On-time return is the product.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/3.source_en: No significant stairs except optional Bukchon viewpoints.
